label: Avalara AvaTax
description: Calculate sales tax with Avalara AvaTax at checkout and record paid orders in AvaTax for filing. In AvaTax, find the account ID and create a license key in Settings → License and API keys; the company code is in Settings → Manage companies. After saving, turn AvaTax on in Settings → Taxes.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the account ID, license key and company code

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Sandbox accounts work only with Sandbox, production accounts only with Production

fields.label: Account ID
fields.description: AvaTax → Settings → License and API keys

fields.label: License key
fields.description: Generate one on the same page; generating a new key stops the old one

fields.label: Tax calculation
fields.description: Taxes are calculated for carts, orders, subscriptions and invoices once the customer has entered an address with a zip code, or a street, city and state.

fields.label: Reject when AvaTax fails
fields.description: When AvaTax can't calculate taxes, reject the cart or order change with an error instead of continuing without tax

fields.label: Default product tax code
fields.description: Used for products without a tax code (product → Tax code). P0000000 is taxable tangible goods.

fields.label: Shipping tax code
fields.description: Used for shipping services without a tax code of their own

fields.label: Recording sales
fields.description: Paid orders and invoices are saved in AvaTax as committed sales invoices, with the order number as the document code (invoices get I- in front). Changes and returns update the document; canceling the order voids it.

fields.label: Record paid orders in AvaTax
fields.description: Needed for AvaTax returns and reports. Turn off if another system records the sales.
